testCase.name: [local] S24 A wrong device clock or another time zone does not change dictation (3.8)

descriptionHtml:
Bug B33 · P2 · new

A wrong device clock breaks sign-in and dictation: a 12+ hour jump signs the physician out on reload (the server session is still valid); a clock 70+ s fast makes every dictation fail with 'couldn't start'

Tickets: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94423 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: partly · found on: local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S07

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S24 A wrong device clock or another time zone does not change dictation (3.8)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Dictation behaves the same whatever the device clock or time zone: a phone with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone gets the same result as any other device. (UAT 3.8)
  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (TFA-94423 AC 1; TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09))

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Same setup as S01/S02; the server mints a credential that OpenAI expires 60 s after creation, and the browser checks it against the device clock

When Dictate H-01 (Hospital) and N-01 (Nursing Home) with the browser clock shifted by +50 s, +70 s, +1 day and −1 day, and with an unshifted clock in another time zone

Then Every cell gives the same exact text as the unshifted take, with one gpt-live-transcribe prepareSession row and no 'Live dictation couldn't start' message

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8: a phone with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone shows the same state as any other device (U9); each cell must equal the control under the S01/S02 checks (U1) with the engine attributed (T1). On main liveSession.ts:388 throws 'Expired session' when expires_at × 1000 ≤ Date.now(), so the +70 s and +1 day cells are expected to fail even after the one retry; …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa; TFA-94513 in progress

On a phone whose clock is 70 seconds or more fast, every dictation fails with 'Live dictation couldn't start' and nothing is transcribed, and a phone a day fast opens on the sign-in screen.

Evidence: allure-results/40bdcb76…: 13/18 pass. With the clock +70 s or +1 day, every take ends in 'Live dictation couldn't start' with an empty box: liveSession.ts compares OpenAI's expires_at (created + 60 s) with the device clock. With +1 day the app also opens on the sign-in screen. A matrix risk predicted this; it is not in the dev report, ledger or knownGaps.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S24

A wrong device clock or another time zone does not change dictation (3.8)

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-dictation: status failed in aicheck-dictation/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (aicheck-dictation/plan.json, automatable: yes): scripted far end with the REAL prepareSession (realPrepare: OpenAI's real expires_at against the shifted clock; ≤ 2 mints per cell, no audio); addInitScript shifts Date/Date.now by +50 s, +70 s, +1 day, -1 day; Playwright timezoneId Asia/Tokyo (control) and Pacific/Honolulu; H-01 Hospital and N-01 Nursing Home; dictation cells: text lands as in the control, one gpt-live-transcribe prepareSession row, no 'Live dictation couldn't start'. Plus one cell per clock: the app opens signed in like any other device (UAT 3.8); when it opens on the sign-in screen that cell fails, the test signs in through the UI, reloads once to see whether it happens again, and still decides the dictation cell. — The failure mode (device clock vs the 60 s expires_at) is checked in the app before anything reaches OpenAI, so the scripted far end decides it.

Detail:

Scripted far end, real prepareSession: the device-clock check (liveSession.ts: expiresAt × 1000 ≤ Date.now()) runs in the browser before any request to OpenAI's realtime endpoint, so these cells decide U9 on their own; the text itself is the scripted transcript. 13/18 decided cells pass; failing: K-2 H-01 dictation (+70 s, Asia/Tokyo) (landed ""; prepareSession rows 2 ["gpt-live-transcribe","gpt-live-transcribe"]; messages ["Live dictation couldn’t start."]); K-2 N-01 dictation (+70 s, Asia/Tokyo) (landed ""; prepareSession rows 2 ["gpt-live-transcribe","gpt-live-transcribe"]; messages ["Live dictation couldn’t start."]); K-3 H-01 dictation (+86400 s, Asia/Tokyo) (landed ""; prepareSession rows 2 ["gpt-live-transcribe","gpt-live-transcribe"]; messages ["Live dictation couldn’t start."]); K-3 N-01 dictation (+86400 s, Asia/Tokyo) (landed ""; prepareSession rows 2 ["gpt-live-transcribe","gpt-live-transcribe"]; messages ["Live dictation couldn’t start."]); K-3 opens signed in like any other device (UAT 3.8) (+86400 s, Asia/Tokyo) (H-01: sign-in screen on load; UI sign-in reached the list; stayed signed in after a reload | N-01: sign-in screen on load; UI sign-in reached the list; stayed signed in after a reload) prepareSession: 16 call(s), 0 stubbed at the socket, 16 real OpenAI mint(s) with …PUMA. Build e02167f; aiProvider:_current {"model":"us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0","provider":"bedrock","transcription":"gpt-live","visionModel":"gemini-2.5-flash","visionProvider":"vertex"}.

Product issue: Phone clock 70 s or more fast (or a day ahead): the physician taps Dictate in the Hospital or Nursing Home pre-round editor, sees 'Listening…', and after one silent retry gets the red banner 'Live dictation couldn’t start. Check microphone access and your connection, then try again.' with an empty box — every take, nothing transcribed. Separately, a phone a day fast opens the app on the sign-in screen instead of the patient list (see the 'opens signed in' cells). Both break UAT 3.8 (a phone with a wrong clock shows the same state as any other device).

Evidence: 15 attached; 1 not attached:

  • aicheck-dictation/artifacts/20261014-fix-client-2/pw/tc23-client-TC-23-S24-a-wr-982cc-e-does-not-change-dictation-dictation/trace.zip — .zip files are not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
